subject: Clarifications requested: SunBank operational resilience RFI
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sunbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@sunbank.com
Date: 2025-06-10 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Operational Resilience & FFIEC-style Controls — SunBank

Neha —

Thanks for the quick engagement this week. Attached is Section B of our operational resilience RFI and a short controls spreadsheet (see attachment). We need a few clarifications to map Redwood's capabilities to our FFIEC-style expectations:

- Control mapping for continuity (RTO/RPO assumptions for hosted vs. dedicated vs. private deployments).
- Audit evidence for access controls, key management (KMS/HSM), and log retention policies (we typically ask for 12–24 months).
- Details on change control, scheduled DR tests, and production failover procedures (we prefer documented tabletop cadence).
- Any third-party subservice providers and how Redwood surfaces their controls to customers.

Can you confirm whether you can provide a consolidated response by EOD Wednesday (6/11)? If not, please propose a mutual action plan with milestones.

Attachment: SunBank_RFI_Section_B.pdf

Best,
Laura Chen
Director, Information Security
SunBank

Subject: Re: RFI: Operational Resilience & FFIEC-style Controls — SunBank

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-10 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI draft — initial edits and clarifications

Neha / team —

Quick pass on the draft attached. Key edits to seed into the final:

1) Data residency & deployment types — clarify that Hosted API endpoints are region-tagged (us-west/us-east/eu-central), Dedicated pools can be pinned to a region, and Private (VPC/on-prem) supports strict network controls and customer-managed KMS. Suggested wording: "Redwood supports region-specific hosted endpoints; customers may choose Dedicated pools with region affinity, and Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) support customer-managed KMS/HSM and do not leave the customer's network perimeter unless explicitly configured."

2) KMS/HSM & key custody — point to the SOC2 artifact and confirm that for Private deployments customers can bring their own key material to a supported HSM via our documented integration APIs.

3) Audit logs & retention — default hosted retention is 90 days for request logs; extended retention (12–24 months) is available as a paid observability add-on. We should offer an evidence matrix: retention level -> artifact (log export, SIEM feed, or on-prem bundle).

4) DR / failover tests — include cadence: quarterly tabletop exercises, annual full failover runbook test for Dedicated customers, and documentation of canary test coverage for Hosted. Also call out our automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants during capacity events.

5) Subservice disclosure — list major cloud infra partners (GCP in us-west, AWS in us-east) and our expectation: each partner's SOC2/Security posture is documented in our vendor pack; we provide customers with vendor attestations on request.

I'll paste a short paragraph below you can drop into the final PDF.

[Kimberly suggested text]
"Redwood's operational resilience program includes region-aware deployment options, customer-managed key support for Private deployments, tiered log retention and export options, and routine resilience testing. Evidence provided in this response includes the 2024 SOC 2 Type II report, control mapping tables, and a summary of DR test dates and outcomes for Dedicated customers. For hosted customers we provide canary and automated fallback summaries as part of the resiliency dashboard"

LMK if you want me to add any specific dates for the DR runs — I can pull the last four quarters.

—Kim
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-11 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Insert: control mapping snippets + test dates

Team —

Below are concise snippets and dates I recommend adding to the response PDF under the "Availability and Resilience" and "Audit Evidence" sections. Paste as-is where applicable.

Availability & RTO/RPO:
- Hosted API: RTO < 60s for streaming start / negligible RPO for model state; per-request latency SLOs published per model in our catalog.
- Dedicated pools: typical RTO 5–15 minutes for node replacement; RPO depends on workload and can be tuned via replication settings for stateful deployments.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): RTO/RPO are customer-configurable and documented in the Private deployment runbook; Redwood supports on-prem replication and offline backup exports.

DR & Test Dates (sample):
- 2024-09-14: Dedicated pool failover exercise (no customer impact; failover time 12min).
- 2024-12-02: Regional canary failover test for hosted endpoints (automated fallback exercised).
- 2025-03-18: Tabletop resilience review with product and SRE (action items closed).

Audit Evidence & Retention:
- SOC 2 Type II (2024) — attached.
- Request logs: default 90-day retention for hosted; 12–24 months for customers with observability retention add-on (exportable as CSV/SIEM feed).
- Key management: KMS integrations documented; Private deployments support HSM-based key custody.

Third-party & Subservice providers:
- Primary infra partners: GCP (us-west), AWS (us-east). Third-party attestations are available in our vendor pack and can be delivered under NDA.

Happy to drop these directly into the PDF.

—Rishi
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@sunbank.com>
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-11 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: Operational Resilience & FFIEC-style Controls — SunBank (Redwood response)

Laura —

Please find our consolidated RFI response attached. The packet includes:
- Redwood_SunBank_RFI_Response_20250611.pdf (control mappings, tabletop cadence, RTO/RPO descriptions, third-party disclosures)
- SOC2-TypeII_2024.pdf (audit report excerpt)

Key clarifications (summary):
- Deployment / residency: Hosted endpoints are region-tagged (us-west/us-east/eu); Dedicated pools can be pinned to a region; Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) permit customer-managed KMS and do not egress telemetry unless configured.
- KMS/HSM: Private deployments support BYOK into supported HSMs; Hosted uses cloud KMS with role-based access and key rotation (details in SOC2 artifact).
- Logs & retention: Default request log retention is 90 days for Hosted. Extended retention (12–24 months) is available via the observability add-on; we can provide exported logs or SIEM feeds under a data-sharing agreement.
- DR testing: We conduct quarterly tabletop exercises and annual full-runbook tests for Dedicated customers. Sample test dates and metrics included in the appendix.
- Subservice providers: primary infra partners and our vendor attestation process are listed in Appendix B; vendor attestations available under NDA.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 2025-06-12: short technical review call (30 min) to go over the control mapping (we are available 10:00–13:00 PT).
- 2025-06-16: provide any follow-up artifacts requested by SunBank (e.g., extended log export, specific runbook excerpts).
- 2025-06-20: target final acceptance of RFI responses or list of outstanding clarifications.

Attachments: Redwood_SunBank_RFI_Response_20250611.pdf; SOC2-TypeII_2024.pdf

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198
